Name: (CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna - Translation Pack QLS
Author: 17SunAndMoon17
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#4D79FF][b]Better NPC Shop - Translation Pack QLS[/b]
[/color][/size][size=4][color=#A3A3A3]High-Quality Translations for LunaGlaze's Mod
[/color][/size][/center]Welcome to the [b]Translation Pack QLS [/b]for LunaGlaze's excellent "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33557](CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna[/url]" mod! This page provides high-quality translations, allowing more players to enjoy its improved shop interfaces and features in their native language.
[size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Languages Available in this Pack:[/color][/b][/size][list][*]Spanish (Spain - es)
[*]Spanish (Mexico - es-MX)
[*]Portuguese (Brazilian - pt)
[*]Russian (ru)
[*]French (fr)
[*]Korean (ko)
[*]German (de)
[/list][color=yellow][i](Note: The base mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33557](CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna[/url]" already includes English and Chinese translations. This pack adds the languages listed above.)
[/i][/color][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Requirements[/color][/b][/size][list][*]The original [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33557](CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna[/url][/b] mod by LunaGlaze. (Original Mod ID: 33557)
[*] [b]ALL dependencies[/b] required by the original "(CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna" mod. Please verify these on the original mod page.
[/list][color=orange][b]Ensure the base mod is installed and working correctly *before* adding this translation pack.
[/b][/color][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Installation Instructions[/color][/b][/size][list=1][*]Ensure you have the original "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33557](CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna[/url]" mod installed and functioning correctly in your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
[*]Download the desired language file from the [b]"Files"[/b] tab of [u][b]THIS PAGE[/b][/u].
[*]Unzip the downloaded file. This will usually create a folder structure similar to `(CP)BetterNPCShopbyLuna/i18n/es.json` (the exact top-level folder name might vary, but it will contain an `i18n` folder).
[*]Navigate to your main `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder and locate the folder for the original mod, typically named `(CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna`.
[*]Open the folder you extracted from the download ([b]Step 3[/b]). Copy the `i18n` folder found inside it.
[*]Paste this copied `i18n` folder directly into the [b]original mod's folder[/b] within your `Mods` directory ([b]Step 4[/b]).
[*]Your operating system [b]WILL likely ask[/b] if you want to merge the `i18n` folders and/or replace files (especially if updating a translation).
You [b][color=red]MUST[/color][/b] select [color=red][b]YES / MERGE / REPLACE ALL[/b][/color] for all prompts. This action correctly adds or updates the translation file(s) within the mod's structure without deleting other vital components.
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI. Ensure your game language is set appropriately in the game's options. The new translations for the shop interfaces should now appear. Enjoy!
[/list][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][list=1][*] This translation pack only provides translation files (within the `i18n` folder structure).
[*]
[*] It is designed to be fully compatible with the base "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33557](CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna[/url]" mod.
[*][*] It should not inherently conflict with other mods, as its sole function is to modify in-game text strings provided by the base mod.[/list][list]
[size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]Credits[/color][/b][/size][/list][list]
[list][/list][list]
[*] A huge thank you to [b]LunaGlaze[/b] for creating the fantastic "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33557](CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna[/url]" mod! All credit for the original concept, features, and functionality belongs entirely to them. [i]Please show your support by visiting and endorsing the original mod![/i][/list][list]
[*] Translations in this pack were brought to you by myself ([b]17SunAndMoon17[/b]) and the collaborative team behind the [b]Translation Pack QLS[/b]. We hope you enjoy the enhanced experience![/list][list]
[/list][/list]
